message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 130, "amount_cents": 8178}, {"order_id": 133, "amount_cents": 6783}, {"order_id": 134, "amount_cents": 8998}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Refunds handoff received from Alpha Co. I need the list of customers and their net balances before paying, so I'll pull orders and refunds first to see who is in the batch.
Orders are in hand for acme, birch, and cobalt. Next I need the refunds list so I can confirm the handoff matches the ledger before fetching balances.
The refunds list matches Alpha Co's handoff exactly. Next I'll get the net balance for each customer in the batch, starting with acme, rather than computing it myself.
Acme's net is 28879, but I should check it against the ledger: orders 130+133 = 43,840 gross, refunds 8178+6783 = 14,961, so net should be 28,879, which matches. Next I'll fetch birch's net balance.
Acme (28879) and birch (61735) net balances are in hand. Cobalt is the only remaining customer in the batch, so I need its net balance before any payouts are recorded.

Birch's net checks out: orders 131 and 134 total 70,733, less refund 134 (8,998), gives 61,735. Cobalt's net also matches its orders (10,547 + 6,294 = 16,841, with no refunds). All three balances reconcile with the ledger, so I'll record payouts, starting with acme.
Acme's payout of 28879 recorded successfully. Birch's net of 61735 reconciles with its orders (70,733) less refund 134 (8,998), so I'll record that payout next.
Acme (28879) and birch (61735) are recorded. Cobalt's net of 16841 matches its orders (10,547 + 6,294) with no refunds, so I'll record its payout to finish the batch.
All three customers have been paid. Each net balance reconciled against the orders and refunds, so the batch is complete.
